slices.title: Add OHDER refactor recommendation engine
slices.description: Create a deterministic engine that converts OHDER entropy, architect status, law violations, and refactor governance hints into a concrete refactor recommendation.
acceptanceCriteria: High entropy pressure produces a concrete refactor recommendation.
Blocking law violations produce a repair recommendation with target signals.
Healthy architecture produces no recommendation.
Recommendations include title, objective, reason, confidence, target signals, and acceptance criteria.
Recommendation output is deterministic for the same inputs.

slices.title: Materialize refactor recommendations into governed ASK tasks
slices.description: Add a runtime and CLI path that creates a governed ASK task from an OHDER refactor recommendation without bypassing normal slice governance.
acceptanceCriteria: A refactor recommendation can be previewed without mutating task state.
A refactor recommendation can be materialized as a created ASK task.
The created task includes recommendation title, objective, reason, and acceptance criteria.
Materialization emits RefactorSuggested.
Duplicate materialization is idempotent for the same recommendation fingerprint.

slices.title: Add refactor confidence and approval governance
slices.description: Implement low, medium, and high confidence behavior so autonomous refactors follow the spec approval model.
acceptanceCriteria: Low confidence recommendations are suggest-only.
Medium confidence recommendations create approval-required tasks.
High confidence recommendations can create governed tasks automatically when policy allows.
Approval and rejection events are emitted as RefactorApproved and RefactorRejected.
Policy can disable automatic high-confidence materialization.

slices.title: Integrate refactor materialization with ask next
slices.description: Make OHDER next-action output provide a concrete refactor materialization command when it recommends create-refactor-slice.
acceptanceCriteria: ask next keeps task-first precedence.
When OHDER recommends create-refactor-slice, ask next includes a concrete refactor command.
ask next includes a compact refactor recommendation summary.
OhderNextActionRecommended includes the refactor recommendation fingerprint.
No task is created by ask next unless policy explicitly allows automatic materialization.

slices.title: Document OHDER refactor governance materialization
slices.description: Update README and operations docs so operators understand how entropy pressure becomes a governed refactor task.
acceptanceCriteria: README explains OHDER refactor materialization and confidence levels.
Runtime architecture docs map refactor materialization to the OHDER loop.
Operator playbooks explain preview, create, approve, and reject flows.
Policy reference documents confidence and auto-materialization defaults.
Full test suite and ASK pre-push check pass after documentation updates.
